# A test build whose translation is in a method of the component it tests, on
# every target a test runs on.
#
# On android a test build holds the page's state in a class, with the method
# a member of it and the locale a field: the class was written through a
# Kotlin context of its own, whose imports reached no file, and the test file
# wrote a fixed list of imports and not the locale's. And a call of the
# method through the instance inside another call, `c.lines().length()`,
# handed the instance to the method as an argument.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '^ok +2 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '^ok +2 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +2 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +2 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +2 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '^ok +2 tests, 0 failures$'

-- app.sngl --
import i18n "sngl:i18n"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

// The package's one $"...", in a method of a component the window renders,
// which only `testGreets` reaches.
component greeting ui.node {
    var counts = [1, 2]

    func lines() list[string] {
        var out list[string] = []
        for var n = counts {
            out.push($"Hi {n}")
        }
        return out
    }

    ui.vbox {
        for var l = lines() {
            ui.text(value=l)
        }
    }
}

component plain ui.node {
    ui.text #t(value="x")
}

ui.window {
    greeting()
}

func testGreets(t test.Test, c greeting) {
    t.assert(c.lines()[0] == "Hi 1")
    t.assert(c.lines().length() == 2)
}

func testPlain(t test.Test, c plain) {
    t.assert(c.t.value == "x")
}
